entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Machine learning and deep learning fundamentals
Convolutional neural networks, recurrent networks, and autoencoders
Generative AI models including large language models
Supervised and unsupervised learning with Python
Libraries SciPy, ScikitLearn, Keras, PyTorch, and TensorFlow
Object recognition, computer vision, NLP, and recommender systems
LLM and RAG applications with Hugging Face and LangChain
reading.format: Hands-on labs, projects, and practical evaluations.
reading.summary: This professional certificate teaches AI engineering skills, including machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI. Completing it shows ability to build, train, and deploy deep architectures and generative AI applications using Python and popular libraries. It is designed to prepare learners for AI engineer roles.
reading.audience: Data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists looking to get job-ready as an AI engineer.
